title: Completed SRIP at IIT Gandhinagar
content: Completed my Summer Research Internship Program at IIT Gandhinagar, focused on Enigma cryptanalysis, mathematical modeling, and simulation. I wrote about the experience in a blog post and shared the research materials on GitHub.

title: Started SRIP at IIT Gandhinagar
content: Started my Summer Research Internship Program at IIT Gandhinagar, exploring the mathematics behind the Enigma machine and cryptanalysis.

title: Appointed Blithchron'27 Design and Tech Coordinator
content: Assumed Leadership as the Design and Tech Coordinator for Blithchron, the annual cultural festival of IIT Gandhinagar.

title: MusicLib Published to Play Store
content: MusicLib has been officially published to the Play Store. You can download it here or visit the website for more details.
